estimand_name: native-read Kraken2-only common classifier-assignment sensitivity estimand
primary_anchor_boundary: PRJNA1056765 frozen Kraken2+Bracken v5 remains the primary anchor analysis
allowed_input_architecture: one repository-declared or frozen-manifest single-read FASTQ per biological sample; no paired mode, orphan synthesis, trimming, length filtering or read-length substitution
raw_count_definition: Kraken2 direct reads assigned to the requested rank/taxon in the standard report; clade counts may be retained separately but must not be substituted silently
relative_abundance_denominator: all input reads for the sample
classified_fraction: Kraken2 classified reads divided by all input reads
unclassified_fraction: Kraken2 unclassified reads divided by all input reads
zero_handling: explicit zero for a taxon absent from a valid sample report; no pseudocount for raw fractions or Bray-Curtis; missing/failed samples are not zeros
filtering_prevalence: primary technical layer retains all rank taxa with at least one direct assigned read; cohort inference uses a prospectively frozen prevalence threshold of at least 10% within that cohort, with 5% and 20% sensitivity views reported without outcome-guided selection
sample_qc: require manifest identity, FASTQ integrity, successful Kraken2 exit and internally consistent report totals; retain low-classified samples with flags; exclude no sample based on clinical group, richness, taxon identity or desired result
alpha_diversity_policy: not a primary endpoint; if reported, observed richness and Shannon are descriptive sensitivity metrics on direct rank counts, rarefaction is not performed, and classified fraction/read depth accompany every value
beta_diversity_metric: Bray-Curtis on all-input-read-denominator direct rank fractions, with no cross-cohort matrix construction
permanova: within cohort only; prespecified clinical group as predictor; include frozen available batch/site covariates only when estimable and non-confounded; 9999 permutations; deterministic cohort-specific seed; report pseudo-F, R2 and permutation p
permdisp: required for every PERMANOVA using the identical sample set, feature space and distance matrix; 9999 permutations with a distinct deterministic seed; dispersion-qualified interpretation mandatory
cohort_specific_analysis: construct, filter, normalize and analyze PRJNA1056765 and PRJCA046985 independently
cross_study_synthesis: compare direction, effect-size structure, uncertainty and robustness qualifications narratively or by prespecified non-pooled summaries; never pool samples, count tables or abundance matrices
prohibitions: Do not modify or overwrite PRJNA1056765 frozen Kraken2+Bracken v5
Do not compare PRJNA1056765 Bracken abundance directly with PRJCA046985 Kraken2 classifier abundance as the same estimator
Do not call Kraken2 classifier fractions Bracken abundance
Do not infer clinical labels from sequences
Do not pass native mixed-length reads to Bracken using a summary length
